Neither declared checker asserts that a permission set granting EventBus.publish access actually names the platform event object it publishes at run time (check_apex_named_credentials_patterns.py does not read PermissionSet files at all, and check_permission_set_architecture.py's dependency-chain rule only checks internal consistency of a declared objectPermissions row, not whether the row the Apex layer needs exists).
